name: Why There Is Only One Well

levels.entry: Forty families and one well. I assumed poverty. Teshk says three others were dug and all three are dry.
The dry ones are shallower. Not much — a few armspans — but all three of them, and this one is not.
So the water is not gone, it is lower, and it is lowering. The rope has been lengthened twice in Teshk's lifetime.
Which gives a rate, and the rate gives a date. Two more lengthenings and this well joins the other three.

notes: Turns the map's history into the inhabitants' future. The only discovery here with a deadline attached.
